_comment: PKI plan NEW-S1-2: the one algorithm policy, read by the Go verifier (go:embed) and the Android wallet (Java resource). Applies to every non-anchor certificate in a validated path. Reference: ETSI TS 119 312 [UNVERIFIED revision]. Add ES384/ML-DSA by adding entries here; both engines pick them up.
_x509_signature_algorithms: ecdsa-with-SHA256/384/512, sha256/384/512WithRSAEncryption. SHA-1 and MD5 are absent, so refused.
_ec_curves: P-256, P-384. P-521 and anything else unlisted is refused.
_rsa_min_bits: 2048 keeps the pilot LOTL signer (RSA-2048) usable; raise to 3072 when the LOTL signer rotates [UNVERIFIED TS 119 312 deadline].
